headlines.name: Ebola outbreak remains out of control in Congo 6 months into response
headlines.headline: Ebola outbreak remains out of control in Congo 6 months into response
headlines.description: More than 11,000 cases have been recorded, and nearly half of those infected have died, according to government data. It is the deadliest of Congo’s 17 outbreaks and is on track to surpass the death toll from the West African outbreak that killed 11,000 people between 2014 and 2016.

headlines.name: Nvidia
headlines.headline: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says if Nvidia was a bank, ‘a lot of the executives would be removed’ — while Huang reportedly eyes return
headlines.description: After blaming Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick for not blacklisting a company suspected of funneling AI chips to China, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent put Nvidia on blast. The Treasury Department and other federal agencies were in favor of placing trade restrictions on Megaspeed , the cloud computing company at the center of Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
